name: IC RF — SOP
description: RF IC cluster containing 5 surface-mount parts in SOP package variants including standard SOP-8 and exposed-pad SOP-8-1EP footprints from KiCad symbols.
selection_hints: Select based on whether an exposed pad (SOP-8-1EP) or standard SOP-8 footprint is required.
Verify footprint dimensions (4.57x4.57mm vs 3.76x4.96mm) against layout requirements.
Choose among KSW, KSWA, KSWHA, MSW, and MSWA series parts based on symbol specifications.
avoid_when: The PCB design requires non-SOP or through-hole component packaging.
Package dimensions or lead pitch differ from the SOP-8 1.27mm pitch footprints in this cluster.
Quality tiers higher than Tier B are strictly required.
